description: Fork of exp475 (bs=16, 1.4962). SINGLE change: LUT params in the last 2 layers (L4,L5) get lut_lr * 3 (=6e-4); early layers stay at 2e-4. Non-zero-sum lever (scales late-layer step size, steals gradient from nothing) — unlike inv-freq weighting (exp487, failed because zero-sum). Tests whether the late layers are UNDERTRAINED at bs=16: the exp486 logit-lens probe showed the entire bs=48 gain is built in L4/L5 (delta L5 -0.086, L6 -0.136), early layers slightly worse. If late layers just under-move at small batch, a higher LR there recovers part of the gain at 1x tokens. Risk: bs=16's late-layer problem may be gradient NOISE not SIZE, in which case higher LR amplifies noise.
